prior_evidence.nkr10_pr1140: 83 templates >=6 unique supporting anchor subjects, 32,768 sampled historical TRAIN anchors; no independent predictions
prior_evidence.sibling_nkr10_pr1141: Fixed P31/P279 masked historical TRAIN recall@4 106/1270=8.346%, below prereg 10%; exact symbolic tie; no repeat or retune

question: Do source-inducted NKR10 non-token (P1,P2)->P3 rules transfer to subject-disjoint historical TRAIN positives when no query target edge is available to the predictor, and how do they compare with an equal-evidence independently implemented exact symbolic rule learner and frequency prior?

design.source: previously consumed noncanonical historical Wikidata5M TRAIN only
design.anchor_sampling: K=min(65536,rows), row_index=floor(k*(N-1)/(K-1)); no adaptive or randomized resampling
design.split: SHA256 ASCII 'nkr11-subject-v1:'+decimal(subject), first digest byte modulo 4; bucket0=heldout DEV, bucket1,2,3=TRAIN; all source anchors for same subject strictly one partition
design.training: Discover templates only on TRAIN anchor direct target edges X-P3-Z with bounded (X-P1-Y,Y-P2-Z) source witnesses; first 8 *sorted outgoing triples* per subject/intermediate, no P3 equal to P1/P2; unique supporting TRAIN subjects per template; min support 6; rank support descending then key ascending; cap 128 selected template identities; training frequency-only object top10 per target P3 from TRAIN anchor positives.
design.evaluation: Group heldout anchor positives by (subject,p3) with their distinct known-positive objects; every group included without outcome-based filtering; predictor receives only subject and target P3, never observed target objects; for each induced rule retrieve at most 8 objects for each source (s,p1) and at most 8 for each (mid,p2), never request (s,p3); rank proposed object by MAX training support for its witnessed rule templates, tie by object integer ascending, max 256 candidates; no missing edge interpreted as negative; count Hits@1/10 if ANY withheld anchor positive belongs to top K; zero proposals=miss for all-heldout metric
references: independent exact symbolic path count reimplementation fitted on same disclosed training anchors, same selected keys/counts, same query source, expected tie
top-10 observed source training object-frequency-only prior (no relation composition)
removed training direct target rule witness negative
heldout target-object substitution and duplicate training anchors negative
cold deterministic same source replay and no mutation
design.target_exposure: The original historical TRAIN image is previously consumed; this is a retrospective split within known data, NOT a prospective first-use. API-level predictor is denied direct heldout P3 objects; raw source loader can see all triples only to form/pin masked holdout evaluator. Do not claim fully blind independent novel-source transfer.
design.frozen_dev_rule: At least 64 heldout (s,p3) groups with a nonempty candidate path, at least 10% Hits@10 over ALL heldout positive groups AND >=5 percentage point absolute Hits@10 improvement over training-object-frequency prior; regardless of this outcome scientific_pass=false. Report conditional covered Hits@10 separately without using it to rescue a failure.
design.scientific_requirement: Independent genuinely unconsumed new-source and causal action/outcome first use, fully trained conventional baselines with matched information and actions, cost, controlled interventional value, cold retention and unfamiliar-law transfer; entirely outside this diagnostic.
design.stop: Source SHA/metadata drift; original valid/test or protected data; masked target passed into predictor; result-dependent cohort/model changes; branch contract drift; budget exhaustion; failed Linux/Windows full regression or G29; forbidden accepted-state write
